newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Holderbank to buy Cementos del Norte.
newsitem.headline: Holderbank to buy Cementos del Norte.

text.p: Holderbank Financiere Glarus said its Mexican unit Apasco SA de CV and Guatemalan investors would acquire a minority stake in Cementos del Norte SA in Honduras.
No financial terms were disclosed in a statement.

"The move will give Apasco a stronger foothold in Central America. At the same time, this investment will push the natural boundaries of Apasco's market territory further south while expanding the group's network in the region," it said.
It said Cementos del Norte's plant near San Pedro Sula had an annual capacity of around 700,000 tonnes of cement.
Honduran cement consumption is now around one million tonnes per year, with construction trends pointing to continuous growth over the next few years, it added.
Company officials were not immediately available to provide more details.
A Holderbank spokesman said the exact size of the minority stake, which Apasco would split 50/50 with its Guatamalan partners, remained to be set.
This would determine the final price to be paid for the stake, he added.
"But we can say that on the basis of capacity-tonnes, the amount will be just under $100," he said.
